package courseclient

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"mime"
	"net/http"
	"net/url"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/usecase/answer"
)

// Client implements answer.TaskProvider using ms-course-service HTTP API.
type Client struct {
	BaseURL          string
	InternalToken    string
	HTTPClient       *http.Client
	AssignmentAccess answer.AssignedCourseAccess
}

func (c Client) GetLesson(ctx context.Context, lessonID string) (*answer.LessonMetadata, error) {
	if c.BaseURL == "" {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("course service base url is empty")
	}
	publicAccessErr := c.requirePublicAccess(ctx, "lesson", lessonID)
	if publicAccessErr != nil && !c.canTryAssignedAccess(ctx, publicAccessErr) {
		return nil, publicAccessErr
	}
	endpoint := fmt.Sprintf(
		"%s/internal/lesson/get-internal-lesson/%s",
		strings.TrimRight(c.BaseURL, "/"),
		lessonID,
	)
	req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodGet, endpoint, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if c.InternalToken != "" {
		req.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", c.InternalToken)
	}
	client := c.HTTPClient
	if client == nil {
		client = &http.Client{Timeout: 10 * time.Second}
	}
	safeClient := *client
	safeClient.CheckRedirect = func(*http.Request, []*http.Request) error { return http.ErrUseLastResponse }
	resp, err := safeClient.Do(req)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer func() { _ = resp.Body.Close() }()

	switch resp.StatusCode {
	case http.StatusNotFound:
		return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
	case http.StatusForbidden, http.StatusUnauthorized:
		return nil, domain.ErrForbidden
	}
	if resp.StatusCode >= 400 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("course service error: %s", resp.Status)
	}

	var payload struct {
		ID          string `json:"id"`
		CourseID    string `json:"course_id"`
		Title       string `json:"title"`
		Excerpt     string `json:"excerpt"`
		Description string `json:"description"`
		Order       int    `json:"order"`
		Status      int    `json:"status"`
	}
	if err := json.NewDecoder(resp.Body).Decode(&payload); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if payload.ID == "" {
		return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	result := &answer.LessonMetadata{
		ID:          payload.ID,
		CourseID:    payload.CourseID,
		Title:       payload.Title,
		Excerpt:     payload.Excerpt,
		Description: payload.Description,
		Order:       payload.Order,
		Status:      payload.Status,
	}
	if publicAccessErr != nil {
		if err := c.requireAssignedAccess(ctx, result.CourseID, publicAccessErr); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		answer.MarkPublicContentAccessVerified(ctx, "lesson", lessonID)
	}
	if relationID, publicRequest := answer.PublicContentAccessFromContext(ctx); publicRequest && relationID == "" && result.CourseID != "" {
		answer.MarkPublicContentAccessVerified(ctx, "course", result.CourseID)
	}
	return result, nil
}

// GetTask fetches task metadata via internal endpoint.
func (c Client) GetTask(ctx context.Context, taskID string) (*answer.TaskMetadata, error) {
	return c.getTask(ctx, taskID, true, false)
}

// GetDiagnosticTask is a deliberately narrow trusted read used only after the
// Student diagnostic aggregate has proved owner and frozen-task membership.
// Unlike GetTask it performs no public/assignment gate, so an intentionally
// catalog-hidden curated diagnostic can still be rendered and scored.
func (c Client) GetDiagnosticTask(ctx context.Context, taskID string) (*answer.TaskMetadata, error) {
	return c.getTask(ctx, taskID, false, true)
}

func (c Client) getTask(ctx context.Context, taskID string, enforceAccess, strictDiagnostic bool) (*answer.TaskMetadata, error) {
	if c.BaseURL == "" || (strictDiagnostic && (strings.TrimSpace(c.InternalToken) == "" || !canonicalCatalogUUID(taskID))) {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("course service base url is empty")
	}
	var publicAccessErr error
	if enforceAccess {
		publicAccessErr = c.requirePublicAccess(ctx, "task", taskID)
		if publicAccessErr != nil && !c.canTryAssignedAccess(ctx, publicAccessErr) {
			return nil, publicAccessErr
		}
	}
	endpoint := fmt.Sprintf(
		"%s/internal/task/get-internal-task/%s",
		strings.TrimRight(c.BaseURL, "/"),
		taskID,
	)
	req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodGet, endpoint, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if c.InternalToken != "" {
		req.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", c.InternalToken)
	}
	client := c.HTTPClient
	if client == nil {
		client = &http.Client{Timeout: 10 * time.Second}
	}
	safeClient := *client
	safeClient.CheckRedirect = func(*http.Request, []*http.Request) error { return http.ErrUseLastResponse }
	resp, err := safeClient.Do(req)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer func() { _ = resp.Body.Close() }()

	switch resp.StatusCode {
	case http.StatusNotFound:
		return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
	case http.StatusForbidden, http.StatusUnauthorized:
		return nil, domain.ErrForbidden
	}
	if (strictDiagnostic && resp.StatusCode != http.StatusOK) || resp.StatusCode >= 400 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("course service error: %s", resp.Status)
	}

	var payload struct {
		ID                  string                     `json:"id"`
		LessonID            string                     `json:"lesson_id"`
		CourseID            string                     `json:"course_id"`
		Title               string                     `json:"title"`
		Description         string                     `json:"description"`
		Translations        json.RawMessage            `json:"translations"`
		Status              int                        `json:"status"`
		LearningTargets     []domain.LearningTargetRef `json:"learning_targets"`
		Type                any                        `json:"type"`
		TaskKind            string                     `json:"task_kind"`
		CodeStructureTypeID string                     `json:"code_structure_type_id"`
		CodeStructureType   string                     `json:"code_structure_type_code"`
		CodeStructure       json.RawMessage            `json:"code_structure"`
		ComposeConfig       json.RawMessage            `json:"compose_config"`
		AllowedErrorsCount  int                        `json:"allowed_errors_count"`
		StarterFiles        []struct {
			Type          int16  `json:"type"`
			FileStorageID string `json:"filestorage_id"`
			Order         int    `json:"order"`
		} `json:"starter_files"`
		Tests []struct {
			ID           string          `json:"id"`
			SourceKey    string          `json:"source_key"`
			TaskID       string          `json:"task_id"`
			Kind         string          `json:"kind"`
			Title        string          `json:"title"`
			Description  string          `json:"description"`
			Translations json.RawMessage `json:"translations"`
			Order        int             `json:"order"`
			Groups       []struct {
				ID           string          `json:"id"`
				TaskTestID   string          `json:"task_test_id"`
				Title        string          `json:"title"`
				Translations json.RawMessage `json:"translations"`
				Order        int             `json:"order"`
			} `json:"groups"`
			Variants []struct {
				ID             string          `json:"id"`
				SourceKey      string          `json:"source_key"`
				TaskTestID     string          `json:"task_test_id"`
				Text           string          `json:"text"`
				IsCorrect      bool            `json:"is_correct"`
				CorrectOrder   *int            `json:"correct_order"`
				GroupID        string          `json:"group_id"`
				GroupSourceKey string          `json:"group_source_key"`
				Translations   json.RawMessage `json:"translations"`
				Order          int             `json:"order"`
			} `json:"variants"`
		} `json:"tests"`
		ExecutionMode          string     `json:"execution_mode"`
		EvaluationMode         string     `json:"evaluation_mode"`
		UIMode                 string     `json:"ui_mode"`
		SubmissionMode         string     `json:"submission_mode"`
		RequiresSandbox        bool       `json:"requires_sandbox"`
		ExposesPreview         bool       `json:"exposes_preview"`
		ExposesTerminal        bool       `json:"exposes_terminal"`
		SupportsLiveValidation bool       `json:"supports_live_validation"`
		Order                  int        `json:"order"`
		MaxAttempts            *int       `json:"max_attempts"`
		DeadlineAt             *time.Time `json:"deadline_at"`
		Version                int64      `json:"version"`
		CreatedAt              time.Time  `json:"created_at"`
		UpdatedAt              time.Time  `json:"updated_at"`
		AssessmentPurpose      string     `json:"assessment_purpose"`
	}
	var decoder *json.Decoder
	if strictDiagnostic {
		media, _, mediaErr := mime.ParseMediaType(resp.Header.Get("Content-Type"))
		if mediaErr != nil || media != "application/json" {
			return nil, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		body, readErr := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(resp.Body, 1<<20+1))
		if readErr != nil || len(body) > 1<<20 {
			return nil, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		decoder = json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(body))
		decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	} else {
		decoder = json.NewDecoder(resp.Body)
	}
	if err := decoder.Decode(&payload); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if strictDiagnostic {
		if err := decoder.Decode(&struct{}{}); err != io.EOF {
			return nil, domain.ErrValidation
		}
	}
	if payload.ID == "" {
		return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	learningTargets, err := domain.NormalizeLearningTargetRefs(payload.LearningTargets)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid course learning targets: %w", err)
	}
	if strictDiagnostic {
		diagnosticTargets, targetErr := domain.NormalizeDiagnosticLearningTargets(payload.LearningTargets)
		if targetErr != nil || len(diagnosticTargets) == 0 || payload.EvaluationMode != "AUTO" || payload.AssessmentPurpose != "diagnostic" || !validDiagnosticTaskType(parseInt16(payload.Type)) || payload.Version < 1 || payload.UpdatedAt.IsZero() || !canonicalCatalogUUID(payload.ID) || !canonicalCatalogUUID(payload.LessonID) {
			return nil, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		learningTargets = diagnosticTargets
	}
	courseID := strings.TrimSpace(payload.CourseID)
	if courseID == "" && strings.TrimSpace(payload.LessonID) != "" {
		if lesson, lessonErr := c.GetLesson(ctx, payload.LessonID); lessonErr == nil && lesson != nil {
			courseID = lesson.CourseID
		} else if publicAccessErr != nil {
			return nil, publicAccessErr
		}
	}
	if strictDiagnostic && !canonicalCatalogUUID(courseID) {
		return nil, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	tests := make([]answer.TaskTestMetadata, 0, len(payload.Tests))
	starterFiles := make([]answer.TaskStarterFileMetadata, 0, len(payload.StarterFiles))
	for _, item := range payload.StarterFiles {
		starterFiles = append(starterFiles, answer.TaskStarterFileMetadata{
			Type:          item.Type,
			FileStorageID: item.FileStorageID,
			Order:         item.Order,
		})
	}
	for _, test := range payload.Tests {
		groups := make([]answer.TaskTestGroupMetadata, 0, len(test.Groups))
		for _, group := range test.Groups {
			groups = append(groups, answer.TaskTestGroupMetadata{
				ID:    group.ID,
				Title: group.Title,
				Order: group.Order,
			})
		}
		variants := make([]answer.TaskTestVariantMetadata, 0, len(test.Variants))
		for _, variant := range test.Variants {
			variants = append(variants, answer.TaskTestVariantMetadata{
				ID:             variant.ID,
				Text:           variant.Text,
				IsCorrect:      variant.IsCorrect,
				CorrectOrder:   variant.CorrectOrder,
				GroupID:        variant.GroupID,
				GroupSourceKey: variant.GroupSourceKey,
				Order:          variant.Order,
			})
		}
		tests = append(tests, answer.TaskTestMetadata{
			ID:          test.ID,
			Kind:        test.Kind,
			Title:       test.Title,
			Description: test.Description,
			Order:       test.Order,
			Groups:      groups,
			Variants:    variants,
		})
	}
	result := answer.NormalizeTaskMetadata(&answer.TaskMetadata{
		ID:                     payload.ID,
		LessonID:               payload.LessonID,
		CourseID:               courseID,
		Title:                  payload.Title,
		Description:            payload.Description,
		Status:                 payload.Status,
		LearningTargets:        learningTargets,
		Type:                   parseInt16(payload.Type),
		TaskKind:               payload.TaskKind,
		CodeStructureType:      payload.CodeStructureType,
		CodeStructure:          payload.CodeStructure,
		ComposeConfig:          payload.ComposeConfig,
		AllowedErrorsCount:     payload.AllowedErrorsCount,
		StarterFiles:           starterFiles,
		Tests:                  tests,
		ExecutionMode:          payload.ExecutionMode,
		EvaluationMode:         payload.EvaluationMode,
		UIMode:                 payload.UIMode,
		SubmissionMode:         payload.SubmissionMode,
		RequiresSandbox:        payload.RequiresSandbox,
		ExposesPreview:         payload.ExposesPreview,
		ExposesTerminal:        payload.ExposesTerminal,
		SupportsLiveValidation: payload.SupportsLiveValidation,
		MaxAttempts:            payload.MaxAttempts,
		DeadlineAt:             payload.DeadlineAt,
		Version:                payload.Version,
		UpdatedAt:              payload.UpdatedAt.UTC(),
		AssessmentPurpose:      strings.TrimSpace(payload.AssessmentPurpose),
	})
	if enforceAccess && publicAccessErr != nil {
		if err := c.requireAssignedAccess(ctx, result.CourseID, publicAccessErr); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		answer.MarkPublicContentAccessVerified(ctx, "task", taskID)
	}
	if enforceAccess {
		if relationID, publicRequest := answer.PublicContentAccessFromContext(ctx); publicRequest && relationID == "" && result.CourseID != "" {
			answer.MarkPublicContentAccessVerified(ctx, "course", result.CourseID)
		}
	}
	return result, nil
}

// GetCourseStructure fetches ordered lessons/tasks for one course.
func (c Client) GetCourseStructure(ctx context.Context, courseID string) (*answer.CourseStructure, error) {
	if c.BaseURL == "" {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("course service base url is empty")
	}
	publicAccessErr := c.requirePublicAccess(ctx, "course", courseID)
	if publicAccessErr != nil {
		if !c.canTryAssignedAccess(ctx, publicAccessErr) {
			return nil, publicAccessErr
		}
		if err := c.requireAssignedAccess(ctx, courseID, publicAccessErr); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		answer.MarkPublicContentAccessVerified(ctx, "course", courseID)
	}
	endpoint := fmt.Sprintf(
		"%s/internal/course/get-internal-course-structure/%s",
		strings.TrimRight(c.BaseURL, "/"),
		courseID,
	)
	req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodGet, endpoint, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if c.InternalToken != "" {
		req.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", c.InternalToken)
	}
	client := c.HTTPClient
	if client == nil {
		client = &http.Client{Timeout: 10 * time.Second}
	}
	resp, err := client.Do(req)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer func() { _ = resp.Body.Close() }()

	switch resp.StatusCode {
	case http.StatusNotFound:
		return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
	case http.StatusForbidden, http.StatusUnauthorized:
		return nil, domain.ErrForbidden
	}
	if resp.StatusCode >= 400 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("course service error: %s", resp.Status)
	}

	var payload struct {
		CourseID        string `json:"course_id"`
		CourseVersionID string `json:"course_version_id"`
		Lessons         []struct {
			ID          string `json:"id"`
			CourseID    string `json:"course_id"`
			Title       string `json:"title"`
			Description string `json:"description"`
			Order       int    `json:"order"`
			Status      int    `json:"status"`
			Tasks       []struct {
				ID             string `json:"id"`
				LessonID       string `json:"lesson_id"`
				CourseID       string `json:"course_id"`
				Title          string `json:"title"`
				Description    string `json:"description"`
				Type           any    `json:"type"`
				EvaluationMode string `json:"evaluation_mode"`
				Order          int    `json:"order"`
				Status         int    `json:"status"`
			} `json:"tasks"`
		} `json:"lessons"`
	}
	if err := json.NewDecoder(resp.Body).Decode(&payload); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	if payload.CourseID == "" {
		payload.CourseID = payload.CourseVersionID
	}
	if payload.CourseID == "" {
		payload.CourseID = courseID
	}

	result := &answer.CourseStructure{
		CourseID: payload.CourseID,
		Lessons:  make([]answer.CourseStructureLesson, 0, len(payload.Lessons)),
	}
	for _, lesson := range payload.Lessons {
		lessonCourseID := lesson.CourseID
		if lessonCourseID == "" {
			lessonCourseID = payload.CourseID
		}
		item := answer.CourseStructureLesson{
			ID:          lesson.ID,
			CourseID:    lessonCourseID,
			Title:       lesson.Title,
			Description: lesson.Description,
			Order:       lesson.Order,
			Status:      lesson.Status,
			Tasks:       make([]answer.CourseStructureTask, 0, len(lesson.Tasks)),
		}
		for _, task := range lesson.Tasks {
			taskCourseID := task.CourseID
			if taskCourseID == "" {
				taskCourseID = lessonCourseID
			}
			item.Tasks = append(item.Tasks, answer.CourseStructureTask{
				ID:             task.ID,
				LessonID:       task.LessonID,
				CourseID:       taskCourseID,
				Title:          task.Title,
				Description:    task.Description,
				Type:           parseInt16(task.Type),
				EvaluationMode: task.EvaluationMode,
				Order:          task.Order,
				Status:         task.Status,
			})
		}
		result.Lessons = append(result.Lessons, item)
	}

	return result, nil
}

func (c Client) requirePublicAccess(ctx context.Context, kind, id string) error {
	relationID, required := answer.PublicContentAccessFromContext(ctx)
	if !required || answer.PublicContentAccessVerified(ctx, kind, id) {
		return nil
	}

	var resourcePath string
	switch kind {
	case "course":
		resourcePath = "/api/v1/course/get/" + url.PathEscape(id)
	case "lesson":
		resourcePath = "/api/v1/lesson/get/" + url.PathEscape(id)
	case "task":
		resourcePath = "/api/v1/task/get/" + url.PathEscape(id)
	default:
		return fmt.Errorf("unsupported public course resource: %s", kind)
	}

	query := url.Values{"fields": []string{"id"}}
	if relationID != "" && kind != "course" {
		query.Set("via_relation_id", relationID)
	}
	endpoint := strings.TrimRight(c.BaseURL, "/") + resourcePath + "?" + query.Encode()
	req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodGet, endpoint, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if userID, role, ok := answer.PublicContentAudienceFromContext(ctx); ok {
		req.Header.Set("X-User-ID", userID)
		req.Header.Set("X-User-Role", role)
	}
	client := c.HTTPClient
	if client == nil {
		client = &http.Client{Timeout: 10 * time.Second}
	}
	resp, err := client.Do(req)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer func() { _ = resp.Body.Close() }()

	switch resp.StatusCode {
	case http.StatusNotFound:
		return domain.ErrNotFound
	case http.StatusForbidden, http.StatusUnauthorized:
		return domain.ErrForbidden
	case http.StatusBadRequest:
		return domain.ErrValidation
	}
	if resp.StatusCode < http.StatusOK || resp.StatusCode >= http.StatusMultipleChoices {
		return fmt.Errorf("course service public access error: %s", resp.Status)
	}

	answer.MarkPublicContentAccessVerified(ctx, kind, id)
	return nil
}

func (c Client) canTryAssignedAccess(ctx context.Context, publicAccessErr error) bool {
	if c.AssignmentAccess == nil ||
		(!errors.Is(publicAccessErr, domain.ErrNotFound) && !errors.Is(publicAccessErr, domain.ErrForbidden)) {
		return false
	}
	studentID, role, ok := answer.PublicContentAudienceFromContext(ctx)
	if !ok || strings.TrimSpace(studentID) == "" {
		return false
	}
	role = strings.ToUpper(strings.TrimSpace(role))
	return role == "STUDENT" || role == "STUDENT_PRO"
}

func (c Client) requireAssignedAccess(ctx context.Context, courseID string, publicAccessErr error) error {
	if !c.canTryAssignedAccess(ctx, publicAccessErr) || strings.TrimSpace(courseID) == "" {
		return publicAccessErr
	}
	studentID, _, _ := answer.PublicContentAudienceFromContext(ctx)
	allowed, err := c.AssignmentAccess.CanAccessCourse(ctx, studentID, courseID)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if !allowed {
		return publicAccessErr
	}
	answer.MarkPublicContentAccessVerified(ctx, "course", courseID)
	return nil
}

func parseInt16(value any) int16 {
	switch v := value.(type) {
	case int:
		return int16(v)
	case int16:
		return v
	case int32:
		return int16(v)
	case int64:
		return int16(v)
	case float64:
		return int16(v)
	case json.Number:
		if parsed, err := v.Int64(); err == nil {
			return int16(parsed)
		}
	case string:
		if parsed, err := json.Number(v).Int64(); err == nil {
			return int16(parsed)
		}
	}
	return 0
}
